item.title: Wales beat New Zealand for the first time since 1953
item.body: Wales beat New Zealand 35-28 in Cardiff, their first victory over them in 73 years. The win ended a wait that dated back to 1953 and led to astonishing scenes in the Welsh capital.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🏉 Wales beat New Zealand for the first time since 1953

Wales beat New Zealand 35-28 in Cardiff, their first victory over them in 73 years. The win ended a wait that dated back to 1953 and led to astonishing scenes in the Welsh capital.

Source: BBC Sport | Image: Pixabay
